body:
Fixes #16

## Summary
- Restored the JavaScript workflow filename to `.github/workflows/js.yml` to match the updated npm Trusted Publisher configuration, and updated badges, release-note generation, line-limit checks, and tests.
- Fixed the Rust release metadata drift by aligning `lino-i18n`'s local `lino-i18n-macros` dependency and `Cargo.lock` entries with the workspace version.
- Updated `rust/scripts/version-and-commit.rs` so future release commits rewrite local path dependency versions and workspace package versions in `Cargo.lock` before committing.
- Refreshed the issue 16 case study with the follow-up Rust failure logs, issue screenshot evidence, PR data, and local verification logs.

## Reproduction
- The follow-up Rust release run failed at `cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release` because `lino-i18n` required `lino-i18n-macros = "^0.0.1"` after the workspace had been bumped to `0.1.0`.
- `node --test js/tests/release-delivery.test.js` now covers the Rust local dependency and `Cargo.lock` version consistency so the mismatch is caught before release.
- The JavaScript publish failure was traced to npm Trusted Publisher workflow identity. The issue comment screenshot shows npm now configured for `js.yml`, so the workflow has been renamed back accordingly.

## Evidence
- Investigation write-up: `docs/case-studies/issue-16/README.md`
- Follow-up Rust CI log: `docs/case-studies/issue-16/data/logs/run-26048388072.log`
- npm Trusted Publisher screenshot: `docs/case-studies/issue-16/data/issue-comment-4480171745.png`
- Local verification logs: `docs/case-studies/issue-16/data/verification/`

## Verification
- `node --test js/tests/release-delivery.test.js`
- `npm test`
- `npm run lint` (passes with the existing four warnings, zero errors)
- `npm run format:check`
- `npm run check:duplication`
- `bash scripts/check-file-line-limits.sh`
- `npm pack --dry-run`
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all -- --check`
- `cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- `cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features`
- `cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --release`
- `cargo package --manifest-path rust/lino-i18n-macros/Cargo.toml --allow-dirty`
- `cargo package --manifest-path rust/lino-i18n/Cargo.toml --allow-dirty --list`
- Rust helper script compilation through generated `rust-script` packages with `RUSTFLAGS=-Dwarnings`
- `actionlint .github/workflows/js.yml .github/workflows/rust.yml`
